diagnosis: The merchant onboarding link endpoint calls stripe.AccountLink.create for an account_id specified in the URL path. It fails to check whether account_id is registered to current_user.id. An attacker can generate onboarding and login links for any pending or active merchant account, allowing them to complete verification with attacker-controlled banking details.
exploit_request:
POST /merchants/acct_1Ox7Y8KjL92/onboarding-link HTTP/1.1
Host: platform.merchant-connect.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Length: 0
